lines.say: switches on GLP-1 receptors; a small molecule, not a peptide
food intake falls, likely through lower appetite
weight fell about 7% to 11% over 72 weeks, vs about 2% on placebo
in type 2 diabetes, HbA1c fell up to 2.2 points (company-reported; not an approved use)
kidney function checked, especially if vomiting or diarrhea is severe
resting heart rate checked; it rose about 4 to 5 beats a minute on average
boxed warning: C-cell tumors in rodents on other GLP-1 drugs; human risk not determined
acute pancreatitis: rare, but more cases than on placebo
stomach contents can be breathed in under anesthesia or deep sedation
nausea in 26% to 35% vs 10% on placebo, plus vomiting, diarrhea and constipation

ask: Which side effects, such as severe stomach pain or a racing heart, mean I should call you?
